title: الحسابات والتقدم بين Global وGarena وChina
content: Garena تدعم cross-progression بين Garena PC وGarena Mobile. الخدمة العالمية تدعم shared progression بين console وPC وmobile عند ربط الحساب المناسب. لا تفترض أن Global/Steam وGarena مزامنة تلقائية: Garena استخدمت Steam-to-Garena transfer service تاريخية بشروط وفترة محددة. title: نسخة الصين من Delta Force

title: موعد إصدار Delta Force على PS5 وXbox

title: موعد إصدار Delta Force Mobile
content: Delta Force Mobile أطلقت عالميًا رسميًا على Android وiOS في 21 أبريل 2025. Garena MENA العربية أعلنت أيضًا 21 أبريل 2025. توجد صفحة Garena إنجليزية إقليمية تذكر 22 أبريل، لذلك يجب إبقاء اختلاف الصفحة الإقليمية وعدم استبدال تاريخ MENA العربي.
source_name: Delta Force official / Garena MENA

title: نسخة Garena Delta Force ومناطق النشر
content: Garena تنشر Delta Force رسميًا على PC وiOS وAndroid في جنوب شرق آسيا وتايوان وأمريكا الوسطى والجنوبية والبرازيل والشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا. Garena PC والموبايل يدعمان مزامنة التقدم داخل نسخة Garena. Garena ليست ناشر نسخة الكونسول. صفحة MENA Mobile CBT ذكرت تركيا والسعودية والجزائر والمغرب وتونس ومصر والعراق وعمان والكويت وليبيا والأردن والإمارات والبحرين وقطر ولبنان.
source_name: Garena Delta Force

title: تواريخ إصدار Delta Force على PC والموبايل والكونسل
content: Delta Force كانت تسمى Delta Force: Hawk Ops ثم تغير الاسم في 20 أغسطس 2024. نسخة الصين على PC والموبايل أطلقت 26 سبتمبر 2024. PC العالمي بدأ Global Open Beta بدون مسح للتقدم في 5 ديسمبر 2024 عبر Official Launcher وSteam وEpic Games Store، وGarena PC أطلقت أيضًا في 5 ديسمبر 2024. الإطلاق العالمي الرسمي والموبايل Android/iOS كان في 21 أبريل 2025. الكونسل PS5 وXbox Series X|S أطلق في 19 أغسطس 2025.

title: شرح طور Black Hawk Down
content: Black Hawk Down هو طور حملة تعاونية وقصصية يعيد تقديم أحداث ومعارك مقديشو بأسلوب سينمائي. الطور مبني على مهام وفصول متتابعة، ويعتمد على التعاون بين أعضاء الفريق وإكمال أهداف المهمة والبقاء. المصدر الرسمي عند إطلاق طور التعاون ذكر أن الفرقة تتكون من 4 لاعبين، كما أضيف لاحقًا خيار Solo على الكمبيوتر. هذا الطور مختلف عن Operations وWarfare لأنه Campaign قصصي تعاوني أكثر من كونه طور استخراج أو PvP واسع النطاق.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Black Hawk Down

title: شرح طور Warfare
content: طور Warfare هو طور قتال جماعي واسع النطاق في Delta Force يركز على المعارك المباشرة والهجوم والدفاع والسيطرة على الأهداف، مع استخدام المركبات والقتال البري والجوي والبحري. الصفحة الرسمية الحالية تعرضه كقتال 24 ضد 24. يختلف عن Operations لأن الهدف في Warfare هو الفوز بالمعركة الجماعية والأهداف، وليس جمع اللوت ثم الاستخراج.
source_name: Delta Force Official Site

title: فكرة اللعب الأساسية في Operations
content: حلقة اللعب الأساسية في Operations هي: تجهيز الفريق قبل الدخول، دخول الخريطة كفرقة من 3 لاعبين، البحث عن موارد ولوت وأهداف عالية القيمة، مواجهة المخاطر والفرق الأخرى، ثم اتخاذ قرار متى وأين يتم الاستخراج. النجاح الحقيقي هو الخروج بالموارد بأمان، لذلك يمكن أن يكون الانسحاب الذكي أهم من الاستمرار في القتال.
source_name: Garena Delta Force Official Site

title: شرح طور Operations
content: طور Operations هو طور استخراج في Delta Force. تدخل المباراة ضمن فرقة مكوّنة من 3 لاعبين، وتختارون العملاء والتجهيزات ثم تدخلون الخريطة لجمع الموارد واللوت واتخاذ قرارات تكتيكية والقتال والبقاء على قيد الحياة. الهدف الأساسي ليس فقط قتل الخصوم، بل الوصول إلى نقطة الاستخراج والخروج بنجاح لتأمين الموارد التي تحملها. الطور يعتمد على مبدأ المخاطرة مقابل المكافأة؛ نجاح الاستخراج يحفظ اللوت، بينما الفشل قد يؤدي إلى خسارة المعدات والموارد التي تحملها. يوجد أيضًا MandelBrick كهدف عالي القيمة؛ يمكن التقاطه وفك تشفيره للحصول على فرصة لمكافآت نادرة، لكن حمله يكشف موقع الفريق للفرق الأخرى. المصدر الرسمي الحالي يؤكد أن حجم الفرقة 3 لاعبين، لكنه لا يحدد رقمًا واحدًا ثابتًا لعدد جميع اللاعبين في كل مباراة أو خريطة من Operations.
source_name: Garena Delta Force Official Site

title: Operations mode overview
content: Operations is Delta Force's extraction-shooter mode. Players form a 3-person squad of Operators and enter a map to plunder valuable resources, make tactical decisions, fight and survive, then reach an Extraction Point to secure the supplies they carry. The mode is built around risk versus reward: extracting successfully secures the loot, while failing the run can cost the gear and supplies being carried. Operations also features high-value objectives such as MandelBrick; decoding it can reward rare items, but carrying it reveals the squad's position to other squads. The official current overview confirms a 3-person squad. It does not define one universal fixed total lobby player count for every Operations map or variant.
source_name: Garena Delta Force Official Site

title: Meltdown season launch
content: The Meltdown season launched with a June 30, 2026 update. Its headline additions included Engineer operator N-Two, the AZ3 Nuclear Power Plant Operations map, the Coliseum Warfare map, a new vehicle, new weapons and ammunition, an Operations mode addition, and a Black Site system update.

title: N-Two operator identity
content: Gabriel Mercier, codename N-Two, was introduced as an Engineer operator in the Meltdown season.

title: N-Two core abilities
content: N-Two uses a Frost Launcher that fires cryogenic grenades, a Cryo-Flask that creates a low-temperature zone, and a Homing Stun Grenade. His Operations trait Frostbite and Warfare trait Permafrost both build cold effects that slow enemies, with mode-specific secondary effects.

title: AZ3 Nuclear Power Plant
content: AZ3 Nuclear Power Plant was added as an Operations map in Meltdown. Official patch notes state that Easy and Normal operations take place there and that radiation can accumulate in contaminated areas or while searching radiation containers.

title: AZ3 Normal access value
content: At Meltdown launch, the official patch notes listed the Normal operation access value for AZ3 Nuclear Power Plant as 112,500 Tekniq Alloy.

content: Recommendation: after scrims, review deaths, failed extractions or lost objectives, communication timing, utility usage, rotations, and repeated positioning mistakes. Convert recurring issues into one or two measurable goals for the next scrim block.

title: Tournament preparation checklist
content: Recommendation: verify the latest tournament rulebook, roster eligibility, map/mode pool, check-in times, patch version, prohibited settings or equipment, and tie-break/scoring rules before competition. Do not assume rules from a previous event apply to a new tournament.

title: Community terminology caution

content: System Policy: Official facts, historical information, recommendations, community information, and system policies must remain distinguishable. Recommendations and community claims must never be rewritten as official Delta Force facts.

title: Tournament match mode
content: The 2026 Operations Tournament Handbook specifies Operations mode played as a custom-room competition.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament squad count
content: Tournament custom rooms are configured for a fixed total of six squads.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament round count
content: Tournament matches are configured for four to seven rounds, with detailed rules allowing a maximum of seven rounds.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament intermission
content: The handbook specifies a mandatory ten-minute intermission between rounds.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Killed-in-action spectating with surviving squadmates
content: If a player is eliminated while squadmates remain alive, the eliminated player may spectate their own team.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Killed-in-action spectating after squad elimination
content: If an entire squad is eliminated, its players may spectate the remaining active squads.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament server version
content: The tournament uses a dedicated Echo-version tournament server containing official-server content and balance patches released prior to June 10, 2026.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament server isolation
content: The tournament server and the official live server are separate and do not synchronize player data.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament server languages
content: The tournament server supports multiple language settings, and domestic and international tournament-server versions are described as identical.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Two decoded MandelBricks win condition
content: If any squad successfully decodes two MandelBricks during the match, that squad secures match victory and the match concludes after the current round.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Ranking priority after seven rounds
content: If seven rounds finish without any squad decoding two MandelBricks, ranking is prioritized first by the number of MandelBricks decoded.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament first tiebreaker
content: When squads have the same number of decoded MandelBricks, squad points are used as the next ranking criterion.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament second tiebreaker
content: When squad points are tied, total Operator eliminations are used to determine ranking.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament final listed tiebreaker
content: If Operator elimination counts remain tied, the squad that achieved its eliminations earlier ranks higher.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Operations tournament scoring system overview
content: In the Operations tournament scoring system, a squad total is composed of Kill Points plus Asset Points. Each confirmed Operator elimination is worth 1 Kill Point. Every 2,000,000 in total stash assets earns 1 Asset Point, rounded down. If seven rounds finish without any squad decoding two MandelBricks, ranking is prioritized first by MandelBricks decoded; ties are then resolved by squad points, then total Operator eliminations, and then by which tied squad achieved its eliminations earlier.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament points composition
content: A squad total is composed of Kill Points plus Asset Points.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Kill point value
content: Each confirmed Operator elimination is worth one Kill Point in the tournament scoring system.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Asset point value
content: Every 2,000,000 in total stash assets earns one Asset Point, rounded down. Values below a full 2,000,000 threshold do not earn the next point.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Asset reporting standard
content: Final asset ranking is based on the Fund Flow panel shown in the post-match lobby. Out-of-match operations after the round do not affect the final asset-point calculation.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Black Site progression
content: Tournament accounts are initialized with the Black Site at maximum level.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Operator access
content: All Operators are unlocked on tournament accounts.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament character level
content: Tournament accounts are initialized at character level 20.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament weapon appearances
content: All weapon appearances available on the tournament server, including MandelBrick appearances, are unlocked.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament melee appearances
content: All melee weapon appearances on the tournament server are unlocked.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Operator appearances
content: Operator appearances are disabled on tournament accounts.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament profile cosmetics
content: Operator name cards, calling cards, and badges are disabled on tournament accounts.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Safe Box capacity
content: The tournament account Safe Box capacity is 3 by 3.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament initial stash
content: Tournament accounts start with 1.5 million Tekniq Alloy in the stash.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick delayed availability
content: Tournament MandelBricks become available for pickup only after a configured delay from match start. Before activation they cannot be interacted with and are shown with a countdown.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Initial MandelBrick decode time
content: The initial tournament MandelBrick decoding time is four minutes.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick interruption time reduction
content: When another squad interrupts an active MandelBrick decode, the required decoding time is reduced by 30 seconds. Repeated interruptions reduce it further.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Minimum MandelBrick decode time
content: Tournament MandelBrick decoding time cannot be reduced below one minute and thirty seconds.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick torch/reset timer
content: Once a MandelBrick is picked up, a five-minute reset countdown begins. If the holding squad does not place it at a decoding station before the timer expires, the brick disappears and later resets.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick water reset
content: Dropping a MandelBrick into water triggers its reset.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick reset countdown visibility
content: The MandelBrick reset countdown is globally visible to tournament participants and is not reset by dropping or transferring the brick between squads.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick decode pause after elimination
content: If the squad decoding a MandelBrick is eliminated during decoding, the decoding countdown pauses. Other squads may still capture the brick.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Round 7 Operator selection reset
content: If a series reaches Round 7, all Operator selection counts are reset and every Operator returns to two available uses.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Round 7 full Operator roster
content: In Round 7, players are granted access to the full Operator roster under the tournament selection rules.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Auction House restriction
content: The Auction House is disabled on the tournament server; players cannot buy or sell items through it.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Black Site production restriction
content: Black Site item production is disabled on the tournament server.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament mission restriction
content: Mission-related systems are disabled on the tournament server.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Battle Pass restriction
content: Battle Pass-related systems are disabled on the tournament server.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament event restriction
content: In-game event systems are disabled on the tournament server.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Loadout entry
content: Players can configure equipment and purchase allowed items through the tournament-room Loadout entry.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Initial tournament purchase range
content: Before Round 1, players may purchase unlimited ammunition up to Level 3, helmets and ballistic vests up to Level 4, repair kits up to Level 5, all available weapons and attachments, backpacks, chest rigs, medical items, injectors, and status-treatment items.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Purchase expansion after Round 1
content: After Round 1, Level 4 ammunition becomes available for unlimited purchase on the tournament server.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Purchase expansion after Round 3
content: After Round 3, each account may purchase one Level 5 ammo selection pack and one Level 5 helmet/ballistic-vest selection pack; repair kits up to Level 6 become unlimited.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Level 6 armor purchase restriction
content: Level 6 helmets and ballistic vests cannot be purchased at any point during the tournament.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: AWM ammunition restriction
content: AWM ammunition cannot be purchased in the tournament store; it is obtainable only through airdrops and cannot be stored in the Safe Box.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Tournament healing acceleration
content: Tournament-server repair and healing items are accelerated relative to the official server. Vest and helmet repair kits are described as 25–30% faster, surgical items 30% faster, and Gold/Purple medical kits receive faster activation or use timings.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Tournament item trading prices
content: Tournament item values follow real-time live-server price data, while Black Site merchant purchase and sell prices are set equal to prevent reselling strategies.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Operator ID Tag values
content: Operator ID Tag values increase by round: 0.05M in Rounds 1–2, 0.1M in Rounds 3–4, and 0.15M in Rounds 5–7. ID Tags may be stored in the Safe Box.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Tournament kill reward
content: The handbook specifies a Tekniq Alloy kill reward of 0.8M per player per opposing Operator eliminated in the current round.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament fixed supply
content: A fixed salary of 0.7M Tekniq Alloy per player is automatically distributed after each round from Round 1 through Round 7.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Losing streak compensation
content: Players who repeatedly fail to extract receive automatic losing-streak compensation. The values are 0.2M after one loss, 0.3M after two, and 0.4M from streak counts three through seven; a successful extraction resets the counter.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: First MandelBrick insertion rewards
content: The first squad to insert a MandelBrick in a brick round receives an insertion reward. Values listed are 0.1M in Round 2 and 0.2M in Rounds 4 through 7.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick handover rewards
content: When the decoding squad changes after insertion, the player performing the handover receives a reward, capped at three handover rewards per player per round. Listed values are 0.1M in Round 2 and 0.2M in Rounds 4 through 7.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: MandelBrick decode rewards
content: The player who decodes or copies a MandelBrick while still active receives the decode reward: 0.5M in Round 2, 0.7M in Round 4, 0.8M in Round 5, and 1.3M in Rounds 6 and 7.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament map pool
content: The Operations tournament map pool contains Zero Dam, Brakkesh, Tide Prison, and Space City.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Zero Dam tournament role
content: Zero Dam is used as an Airdrop-focused tournament map.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Space City tournament role
content: Space City is used as a MandelBrick-focused tournament map.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: Tournament ultra-high-value loot restriction
content: Tournament maps do not spawn the ultra-high-value items Heart of Africa, Medical Ventilator, or Tear of the Ocean.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament Easter Egg crate restriction
content: Easter Egg crates do not spawn on tournament maps.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament insertion points
content: Insertion-point locations are fixed for each tournament map.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament insertion tiers
content: Tournament insertion points are categorized as T1 Red, T2 Yellow, and T3 Blue.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tournament insertion balance
content: A squad will not spawn at the same insertion tier in consecutive rounds; a squad at T1 in one round must receive T2 or T3 in the next round.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Space City tournament-exclusive extraction
content: When a squad both decodes two MandelBricks and clears Space City, a tournament-exclusive extraction point appears in the core area near the helicopter extraction point and the winning squad must extract there.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Brakkesh tournament-exclusive extraction
content: When a squad both decodes two MandelBricks and clears Brakkesh, a tournament-exclusive extraction point appears in the museum sector near the north-entrance statue and the winning squad must extract there.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tide Prison tournament-exclusive extraction
content: When a squad both decodes two MandelBricks and clears Tide Prison, a tournament-exclusive extraction point appears in the outdoor helicopter-landing-pad area and the winning squad must extract there.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Space City MandelBrick activation wait
content: The tournament configuration lists a one-minute MandelBrick activation waiting time for Space City.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Space City decoding stations
content: The tournament configuration uses one Space City MandelBrick template with five decoding stations in total.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: Tide Prison decoding stations
content: The tournament configuration uses one Tide Prison MandelBrick template with three decoding stations in total.
source_name: 2026 Delta Force (V06.10) Tournament Handbook

title: RISE SERIES official competition
content: DELTA FORCE RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 is an official competition for the PC version of Delta Force and its rulebook is based on the 2026 Delta Force Operations Tournament Official Rulebook.

content: RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 is conducted across AMERICAS and EMEA regions, with participation limited to countries supported by official game-server service areas.

title: RISE SERIES minor penalty impact
content: Each minor penalty point in the RISE SERIES results in a one-percent deduction from prize earnings.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: RISE SERIES major penalty impact
content: Each major penalty point in the RISE SERIES results in a five-percent deduction from prize earnings.
source_name: Delta Force RISE SERIES 2026 Season 1 Official Rulebook v1.1.5

title: RISE SERIES disqualification
content: Severe violations such as cheating, match-fixing, repeated failure to appear, or serious misconduct can lead to disqualification and forfeiture of prize money.

title: Operations mid-season event period
content: The Meltdown Operations mid-season update event runs July 31 through September 7, 2026 and rewards Season EXP that can be exchanged for themed rewards.

title: Treasure Hunt across Operations maps
content: The July 30 update states that Treasure Hunt begins August 8 and that every Operations map is stocked with treasure-hunt rewards during the event.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: Faction War online tournament
content: Faction War is an online tournament/event listed for July 31–August 26, 2026.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: 4v4 Tactical Team Deathmatch
content: A season-limited 4v4 Tactical Team Deathmatch event is listed for July 31–August 20, 2026 in Warfare.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: MK4 Fencer Barrel penetration buff
content: In Operations, MK4 Fencer Barrel armor penetration increased from 30 to 35 in the July 30, 2026 mid-season balance update.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: MK4 Deep Space Chrome Barrel buff
content: In Operations, MK4 Deep Space Chrome Barrel firing damage increased from 32 to 34 and armor penetration from 27 to 30; hip-fire behavior was also adjusted.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: SCAR-H limb multiplier buff
content: In Operations, SCAR-H limb damage multiplier increased from 0.4x to 0.5x in the July 30, 2026 update.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: Compound Bow HVK Speed Magazine buff
content: The Compound Bow HVK Speed Magazine fire rate increased from 227 to 260 rounds/min; effective range/muzzle velocity attributes were added and headshot multiplier increased from 1.7x to 2.0x.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: SVCH Warfare reserve ammo buff
content: In Warfare, SVCH reserve ammo increased from 60 to 180 in the July 30, 2026 update.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - July 30 Mid-Season Update

title: N-Two Frost Launcher
content: N-Two can equip a Frost Launcher for a short duration and fire up to six cryogenic grenades; explosions deal damage and apply a cryogenic effect, while continuous firing increases fire rate.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: N-Two Cryo-Flask
content: N-Two can throw a Cryo-Flask that creates a low-temperature gas zone; enemies in the zone suffer cold effects and cough, and the effect can freeze closed doors.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: N-Two Homing Stun Grenade
content: N-Two has an auto-tracking stun grenade that disrupts enemy vision and deals damage.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: N-Two Frostbite in Operations
content: In Operations, N-Two's low-temperature effects gradually slow enemies toward freezing and reduce enemy fracture resistance.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: N-Two Permafrost in Warfare
content: In Warfare, N-Two's low-temperature effects gradually slow enemies toward freezing and reduce vehicle handling.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: AZ3 radiation mechanic
content: On AZ3, entering contaminated areas or searching radiation containers accumulates radiation that affects the character.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: AZ3 difficulty modes
content: The Meltdown patch notes state that AZ3 supports Easy and Normal Operations.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

content: AZ3 Normal Operations access value is listed as 112,500 Tekniq Alloy.
source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

title: Neural Device Agent-H1000
content: The AZ3 Nuclear Power Plant includes the Warlord Neural Device Agent-H1000, described as highly agile and operating in core facilities while connected to Skynet.

source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

source_name: Garena Delta Force - Meltdown Patch Notes

content: Morse's Advanced Sonar Device periodically scans a designated area, counts enemies, and precisely marks enemies who make sound.

content: Morse's Throwable Jammer interferes with enemies in range, causing effects including slow, blurred vision, turning difficulty, reduced hearing and continuous sound.

title: Gizmo Firewall trait
content: Gizmo's Firewall trait improves weapon handling speed when he is positioned near one of his deployables.

content: Gizmo can deploy a Crawler Nest containing three crawlers that track enemies, explode on proximity, and apply corrosion that increases bullet damage taken.

title: Gizmo Smoke Mine
content: Gizmo's Smoke Mine deploys smart smoke that activates when enemies approach and slows enemies entering it; corroded enemies can be marked in the smoke.

title: Gizmo T.I.M.
content: Gizmo's T.I.M. is a self-propelled device that patrols, hunts detected enemies, and fires a restraining net that limits mobility, prevents ADS and disables operator gadgets.

content: Monument was introduced as a Warfare map in the Ahsarah season.

content: Ahsarah introduced Zero Dam - Sinkpoint as an Operations mini-mode; the listed entry value is 112,500 Tekniq Alloys and Dusk weather can occur.

content: Lever-action Rifle was introduced as a new weapon for the War Ablaze season.
